verdicts.reason: In both candidates the design is broken up. The decorative frame borders, the empty peach panel, the orange flourishes and the pasta sketch are scattered as separate pieces, and the background pasta pattern sits as a large block that competes with the content. Both food photos are shrunk to thumbnail size and pushed into a cluttered middle, while the Cascadia brand block is pushed to the far right with its 'RESTAURANT' line spaced out too far. The two are almost identical: B leaves a slightly better margin to the left of the headline, and A's photos are a little larger, so neither is meaningfully better.
